allocationBoundDerivation: All 4096 full hashes are distinct. Hash routing consumes four bits at each of eight levels, so no terminal collision bucket is needed for these fixed keys, including replacements.

Each branch allocates at most 8+4*16=72 bytes. An overlay allocates 12 bytes. Failed tryOverlay allocates nothing; successful tryOverlay returns directly. fullBranch resolves an arbitrary permitted overlay chain in scratch and allocates exactly one ordinary branch, not one allocation per prior overlay.

Charge at most one 72-byte branch allocation per input record per hash level: for count>4, each partitioned batch frame allocates one branch at its own level; its child frames or <=4 insertAt paths operate only at subsequent levels. For <=4, each insertAt/mergeHashed path allocates at most one branch or overlay per remaining level. Private fresh-node reuse only reduces this bound.
Thus branch allocation <=8*72*n=576n per call regardless of old overlay depth, pointer-distance fallback or repeated replacement history. The bound uses no seed-trie arity or pilot delta.

Numeric leaves have 10 ASCII key bytes and 8 value bytes: each bulk leaf is 40 bytes, pointer storage is 4n, and 14 extra bytes conservatively cover initial and final 8-byte alignment, giving 44n+14. Native branches/overlays are multiples of four bytes and do not call alloc; no further per-node 8-byte alignment is assumed.

Object JSON is ASCII, maximum length 46 bytes; sum of roundUp4(16+10+JSON_length) for all 4096 values is 294512 bytes. Its 4096 input pointers use existing scratch because count<=12288. Fixed plain objects have no callbacks or dependencies.
Numeric seed upper heapEnd=65536+(44*4096+14)+(576*4096)=2605070. Per-call bounds are 576n plus numeric staging or object leaf bytes. Empty/read allocate zero arena payload.

Only public setMany creates writer roots in these fixtures, so no scalar-write journal is introduced. Overlay fallback/materialization is covered as above. Unexpected journals, collisions, key changes or source changes invalidate this fixture-bound proof.
Gmemory=floorPowerOfTwo(floor((67108864-4194304-S)/(6*D))); seed plus two warm plus four measured chunks are all covered. Empty/read D=0 use their operation ceiling.

Each observed endpoint delta must be <= its number of calls times D, and endpoint used must be <= S plus cumulative call count times D. Any excess is a correctness/planning stop; never revise bounds or counts after observing it.
